newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-AWB Australian wheat indicator prices - Oct 2.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-AWB Australian wheat indicator prices - Oct 2.

text.p: International prices for milling and Durum wheat were lower as the weather forecasts for the US Midwest and Central Plains and the Canadian Praries improved, the Australian Wheat Board (AWB) said. Wheat indicator prices for multi-grade contracts 96/97 fell by A$1.00 while Durum remained unchanged. Prices, FOB, in A$ per tonne:

NOTE: The indicator price represents the current state of the international wheat market. It is a cash contract price offered today by the AWB for wheat delivered during the 1996/97 harvest. The offer is valid until 4.30 p.m. Australian Eastern Standard Time (0630 GMT) and Eastern Standard Summer Time (0530 GMT). Indicator prices will be revised daily until October.
